headline: Terry Mulholland no-hits the Giants at the Vet
recap: Terry Mulholland threw a complete-game no-hitter to beat the San Francisco Giants 6-0 at Veterans Stadium, striking out eight and walking none. He faced only 27 batters, the minimum for nine innings, despite a two-out throwing error by third baseman Charlie Hayes in the seventh that put Rick Parker aboard; the next batter, Dave Anderson, grounded into a double play to erase him.
Giants starter Don Robinson took the loss, allowing six runs on seven hits over six innings. Kelly Downs threw two scoreless innings in relief.

The Phillies scored in three innings. John Kruk's first-inning single drove in Darren Daulton, who had walked and moved up on a Von Hayes walk. Philadelphia pulled away in the fifth on a Lenny Dykstra RBI double and a two-run homer by Daulton, then added two more in the sixth on RBI singles from Charlie Hayes and Mulholland himself.
